status: FROZEN at the commit that first adds this file, before any of its compute. It adds two supplementary development studies to amendment 2 and changes nothing there. Executor choices under the delegation.

study_P_prior_variation_linearity.question: does the real-data unfolded result's shift under a change of the MC truth prior to a development vertex equal, cell by cell, minus the estimator's bias at that vertex as a truth (the linear-response relation x(prior_k) - x(cv) = (I - A)(v_k - prior) = -bias(v_k) that makes a data-side prior-variation envelope a bound on the regularization bias over the hull of the vertices)
study_P_prior_variation_linearity.design: the real data under R (5 iterations) unfolded with the MC truth prior reweighted (w_truth and w_reco of every MC row times r(truth); response per event, denominator, background and flux unchanged) to D1 GiBUU/GENIE E_avail, D2 NuWro/GENIE E_avail (W1), D3 GENIE MEC/CV (E_avail,W) (W2), D4 NuWro/GENIE (pT,p_parallel,E_avail) (W3), D5 the anchored NuWro/GENIE q3 | (E_avail, W) conditional ratio (state/s5p/ratios/d5-nuwro-over-genie-q3-given-eavail-w.json, built by s5p_truths.py at 29455b10 from the gen5d predictions; sha256 5a4aae61...), each at amplitude 1; controls: the CV path (--universes CV) and the nominal prior d0 must both equal the N1 base product bitwise
study_P_prior_variation_linearity.comparison: for D1, D2, D4 the noise-free bias at iteration 5 from study K (asimov traces), for D3 the mean residual of the 20 s5e W2 experiments; per reported cell of EW, J and H2: the correlation and least-squares slope between the data shift and minus the bias, and the median |shift + bias| / |bias| over cells with |bias| > 1%
study_P_prior_variation_linearity.use: development evidence for the Stage-3 model-component design only; the data shifts are data-informed widths (no observed central value is compared with any generator) and are recorded as such
